main_measure.name: mean unusual 3-bar return of Sunday cases (return minus coin's normal 3-bar drift)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 100 cases and supporting check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 100 cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual 3-bar return above median forecast minus below median

decided_by: Mean unusual 3-bar return positive with t >= 2 over at least 100 cases, and the supporting check above 0.
reading: Situation bars are Sunday-start daily bars (next bar Monday) whose recorded raw component is > 0 (or, where unrecorded, one-bar and 20-bar price returns both negative) with forecast > 0; cases need close[t+3] inside the same window; cases equal to the median forecast are left out of both supporting groups.
